title: Fix FileSystem dock loading thumbnails for files in collapsed folders
body:
The tree view requested a thumbnail for every file in the project when it was built, including files inside collapsed folders, and each row kept its preview for the whole session. On projects with tens of thousands of images, this exhausts the RenderingDevice texture RID pool: texture creation then fails, the editor floods Output with errors and can crash or hang. Before that, it keeps the dock busy redrawing for minutes.

Only request thumbnails for rows in folders that are expanded all the way up to the root, and not hidden by the search filter:

- `_create_tree()` skips files in collapsed folders.
- Expanding a folder requests its files and those of its expanded subfolders. Collapsing it resets the rows to their type icons, which frees their `CanvasTexture` wrappers.
- After the search filter expands folders while the tree is being rebuilt, the visible matches are requested.
- Replies for rows whose folder was collapsed in the meantime are dropped.
